taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: most plants 0.5 m to 1.2 m tall, within FNA's 0.5-1.8 m.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: shrubs or small trees, sparingly to densely branched, 0.5-1.8 m.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: shrubs or small trees; old stems woody.

traits.rosette.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: stem segments usually alternate; no leaves to speak of.

traits.stem_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: stem segments gray-green or purplish; grey-green in the photos; sRGB by eye.

traits.joint_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: stem segments 2-8 x 0.3-0.5 cm. Anderson (2001 p. 211) gives joints 20-80 cm, which reads as a misprint for the whole branches; FNA's measure is used.

traits.joint_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: stem segments 2-8 x 0.3-0.5 cm.

traits.tubercle_relief.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: tubercles linear, drying as elongate, riblike wrinkles; Anderson (2001 p. 211): no prominent tubercles.

traits.tubercle_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: tubercles linear, 1.1-2(-3) cm.

traits.areole_wool_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: wool white to yellow, aging gray; sRGB by eye.

traits.radial_spines.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: spines 0-1(-3) per areole, usually in apical areoles to well distributed; FNA does not tell radials from centrals.

traits.radial_spine_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: the longest (4-)14-45 mm, erect, flexible.

traits.spine_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: spines red-brown with gray to whitish coat, tips yellow; sheaths gray to purple-gray; whitish in the photos; sRGB by eye.

traits.spine_colour_aged.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: spines aging red-brown, the sheaths grey; sRGB by eye.

traits.glochids.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: glochids in adaxial tuft or crescent to encircling areole, yellow or reddish brown, 1-3(-5) mm.

traits.glochid_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: glochids yellow or reddish brown; yellow drawn; sRGB by eye.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: inner tepals pale yellow to greenish yellow, sometimes tipped red, 5-8 mm; sRGB by eye.

traits.flower_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: flowers 1.5 cm to 2.5 cm across, the inner tepals 5-8 mm long (FNA).

traits.anther_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: anthers yellow.

traits.filament_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: filaments greenish yellow; style yellow.

traits.stigma_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: stigma lobes greenish yellow.

traits.fruit_surface.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: fruits fleshy, smooth, spineless; areoles 16-20.

traits.fruit_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: fruits obovoid, 9-15(-27) x 6-7(-12) mm.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: fruits yellow to scarlet; Kearney and Peebles (1942 p. 615): the small scarlet fruits mark the species; scarlet in the photos; sRGB by eye.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: fruits obovoid, 9-15(-27) x 6-7(-12) mm.

traits.fruit_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 p. 101, 104, 105 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Cylindropuntia leptocaulis: fruits 9-15(-27) x 6-7(-12) mm.

traits.flowering_months.note: Kearney and Peebles, Flowering Plants and Ferns of Arizona (1942) p. 615, Opuntia leptocaulis: southern Arizona, 1,000 to 5,000 feet, May and June; FNA: flowering spring-early summer, sometimes fall (Mar-Aug, Oct).

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: the scarlet fruits ripe and hanging on from October into January, as its common name says.

appearance.note: By eye from the photos (observations 191473774, 87902429, 46330057, 390420539, 99511795, 25594006, 111517420, 278885777): thin grey-green pencil stems with short side branchlets at right angles, one long whitish sheathed spine at many areoles, a tuft of yellow glochids, and glossy scarlet oval fruits in winter. Colours, counts and lengths come from the traits through the family's rules.

generator.params.note: Set by hand for Christmas cholla from Flora of North America vol. 4: a shrub 0.5-1.8 m of pencil-thin segments 2-8 cm long, with short branchlets at right angles along the major axes (branch_angle 65, many generations of small joints). The joints' size comes from the traits through the subfamily's rules; daughters, generations, sag and swell are set by eye against the template.

allometry.note: 0.9 m tall at 20 years in the open, within its sources' range, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added for the Saguaro desert scene (west bajada of Saguaro National Park's Tucson Mountain District, about 750 m), batch s1b (2026-10-19): sizes and forms from FEIS, Kearney and Peebles, Hitchcock and Flora of North America, counts and colours from photos.
